introduction: New Jersey WIC supports pregnancy and young children’s nutrition. Start with the Participant Portal or arrange an appointment with a local WIC agency.
description: New Jersey WIC supports pregnancy and young children’s nutrition. Start with the Participant Portal or arrange an appointment with a local WIC agency.

sections.who: Eligible categories include pregnancy, six months after delivery, breastfeeding within the first year and children younger than five. Residence, income and a nutrition or health risk are assessed by WIC staff.
sections.get: Benefits include selected foods, nutrition education and breastfeeding support. The pre-screen sends information to the local agency; it does not itself finish certification.
sections.docs:
• Identity, residence and income proof.
  • Pregnancy evidence where relevant.
  • A health referral if your provider completed one.
  • Children’s health and vaccination records requested by the clinic.
sections.apply:
1. Submit preliminary information

    Use NJ WIC’s Participant Portal or call a local clinic.

  2. Arrange the assessment

    Confirm which applicants must attend and the records needed for the appointment.

  3. Learn the benefit process

    Ask the agency to explain eWIC shopping, approved foods and future nutrition appointments.
sections.after: Keep appointment and card information. Ask the clinic before buying a product you cannot match to the approved-food guidance.
sections.sources: Checked October 1, 2026 using NJ WIC application and document guidance, Current participant pre-screen pathway, Portal eligibility questions. USA Assistance background guide. Program staff determine eligibility and available assistance.

faqs: Does the portal pre-screen approve benefits?
No. It sends preliminary information to the local agency, which completes assessment.
The state specifically includes families experiencing unemployment or temporary financial hardship.
What residence proof can I use?
The state lists options such as a lease, current state ID or qualifying recent mail; confirm with the clinic.

provenance.scope: Published eligibility, service purpose and application pathway; no unverified financial limits or deadlines included.
